title: Locked Out of the Supper Club
_plantedBugs: p1's cipher card says 'move each letter 3 places' without a direction. EXJ moved back 3 is BUG; moved forward 3 (a shift of 23 the other way) is HAM. Both are real words. The intended answer is HAM, so a blind solver should flag possible_second_answer.

items.name: Menu Card
items.playerText: Tonight's special is written in the chef's code: E X J. Chef's note at the bottom: 'Move each letter 3 places.'

items.name: Wine List
items.playerText: Red: 1987, 1992, 2001. White: 1995. The sommelier circled the oldest red.

items.name: Seating Chart
items.playerText: Booths 1 to 12. Booth 9 is marked with a gold star. Under the star: 'Ask for the special.'

items.name: Recipe Card
items.playerText: The house recipe. The secret ingredient is listed as a single word: NUTMEG.

puzzles.name: Chef's Code

text.rookie: Decode the special on the menu card. Type the 3-letter dish to open the wine list.
text.detective: The chef writes in code. What's the special?
text.mastermind: The special hides in plain sight.

hints: Each letter is shifted in the alphabet.
Count 3 letters along from each letter.
E becomes H, X becomes A, J becomes M: HAM.

puzzles.name: Booth Number

text.rookie: Which booth is your table? Type the number.
text.mastermind: Your coat knows where you sit.

hints: Look at the stamp on the ticket.

text.rookie: Which year did the sommelier circle? Type the 4 digits.
text.detective: The sommelier made a choice. Which vintage?

puzzles.name: Ask for the Special

text.rookie: At the starred booth, ask for the special: type the dish and the vintage together, like DISH1234.
text.detective: Order the special with the right wine.

hints: You already found the dish and the year.
Put the dish first, then the year.

final.text: What's the secret ingredient in the house recipe?
